title: Multiagent Debate Improves Reasoning and Factuality in Large Language Models

defines.name: Multiagent Debate
defines.definition: A black-box prompting procedure where multiple language model instances generate, critique, and revise answers over several debate rounds to reach a consensus final response.

problem: Single-model prompting methods often produce hallucinations and weak reasoning, and they cannot leverage diverse model opinions to reach more accurate answers.
